content: Every wildcard socket connection shall be reset to wildcard using SoAd_ReleaseRemoteAddr() if all of the following conditions apply:  The remote address of a socket connection has been set by SD.  The socket connection is not used by a ClientService anymore. I.e. no Offer was received, a Stop Offer was received or the TTL has expired.  The socket connection is not used by an Eventhandler anymore. I. e. the client has unsubscribed all Eventgroups using this socket connection. The socket connection shall not be reset if the routings get disabled because the SdEventHandlerMulticastThreshold was reached.
